commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step: create dedicated system account =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin --comment "Inventory worker service account" inventorysvc
id inventorysvc

echo "== step: write systemd unit =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory OS comparison worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT_EOF

echo "== step: reload systemd and enable/start service =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service

echo "== step: verify =="
sleep 2
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager
echo "== process owner check =="
ps -eo user,pid,cmd | grep -F os-comparison-worker | grep -v grep
